decisions.reason: The accepted preset and custom tipping controls do not change the Transak provider, conversion asset, supported fiat methods, or buyer prerequisites.
The tipping configuration does not change dashboard access or wallet requirements for receiving commissions and holding prize tickets.
Optional tip choices do not alter the fixed $15 primary mint price; the $0 option preserves the ability to mint without a tip.
The source specifies tip-selection controls but does not change how the $15 primary-sale proceeds are allocated or how fiat fees are treated.
Adding optional tip amounts to the minting page does not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited supply model.
The tipping controls do not change the source, permanence, or display locations of referral codes.
The client accepted tipping controls for the minting page but did not request any corresponding change to the About page copy.
Mint tipping does not change secondary-sale royalty amounts, enforcement, pool funding, or ticket-generation rules.
The accepted tip options do not change badge triggers, thresholds, destinations, or functions.
The source does not change the $5 referral commission, its qualifying trigger, recipient, timing, or delivery destination.
The tipping configuration does not alter Small Block prize amounts, winner count, draw condition, or funding sources.
The accepted tipping controls do not change SIWE authentication or the crypto flows for which wallet authentication is required.
